{{short description|American mathematician}}

'''Peter W. Bates''' is a professor of mathematics at [[Michigan State University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://users.math.msu.edu/users/bates/|title=Peter Bates' Home Page|website=Michigan State University Math Department}}</ref>

Bates received his Ph.D. from the [[University of Utah]] in 1976.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=14848|title=Peter Bates}}</ref>

In 2012, Bates became an inaugural fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|website=www.ams.org|language=en|access-date=2015-08-17|archive-date=2018-08-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>"[https://www.ams.org/grants-awards/ams-fellows/fellows-citations-archive Fellows of the American Mathematical Society Citations Archive]." American Mathematical Society. Accessed September 20, 2026.</ref>
